title: Gira le afah amol tan dacayri
intro: tibba leeh, bohoy le ummatta bohoy le waadol soolak sugteeh, maaqooy, maqab kee rabbo qigdu tammoyse wayta. Sahdayti baxi kallayto ceele sinni duyyek bicsen, oson inki bohoy le hadaf qammaalaanam kee oson sinni Rabbik inki amri kinni way maqambaalin.
clues: Nanu sahdayti baxih inna hinna, akme waytaah, maaqube waytaah, ecla sinni duyyek ginnimteh nan.
nek hunun ixxima timixxigem kee kitaabal baxxaqimte- nanu loowo sinnim hinna mango mara hinna.
Nanu ninni gineenak inkinnah ammirtimna, hinnay nanu amrisak naharal mayabna.
Ayro gufta way, kaafiritte buttah nee fan dufuqse lon, nanu kaadu afak keenih fakenno.
Nanu ken esserenno: sin samadak farmoytit sin fanah mamaatinnaa, ta ayro sin diggossah?
Nanu dacrisnam aracay uli rooci edde yawqem mali- girah yan amotani digaalah.
